skill.name: self-communicate
skill.description: Write, draw, and present engineer-facing material well.

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Engineer-facing prose: choose the document form, write in the target register, use stable terminology, and audit the result.
writing.router_intro: Use these resources as a stack. Choose the document form before drafting, then apply vocabulary and voice, and audit before shipping. Route visual structures to ../drawing/ rather than forcing them into prose.

layers.title: Document shape
layers.description: Determine what kind of document is being written and how that form should be structured.

layers.title: Expression
layers.description: Control sentence-level rhetoric, terminology, and register.

layers.title: Audit
layers.description: Inspect the finished prose against the writing discipline.

drawing.title: Drawing
drawing.description: Visual representations for structures, relationships, teaching figures, measurements, and tabular comparisons.
drawing.router_intro: Choose the representation according to the information being communicated. Use the editorial figure guidance before the realization resource when the visual is teaching a concept. Do not create a diagram merely because prose seems visually plain.

layers.title: Editorial judgment
layers.description: Decide what a teaching figure should communicate and how much it should show.

layers.title: Representation
layers.description: Choose and realize the appropriate visual form.

layers.title: Format audit
layers.description: Validate hand-authored drawing artifacts where applicable.

presenting.title: Presenting
presenting.description: Design the talk as an intellectual and temporal object, realize it as a deck, then construct accessible slides.
presenting.router_intro: Work from the highest abstraction implicated by the task. Do not polish slides when the talk is wrong, and do not redesign the talk when only a slide needs repair.

layers.title: Talk
layers.description: Design the audience transformation, argument or learning progression, presentation moves, activities, and pacing.

layers.title: Presentation type
layers.description: Specialize the talk for the communication setting (lecture, research talk, or a deliberate blend).

layers.title: Deck
layers.description: Realize the talk as a coherent visual sequence.

layers.title: House style
layers.description: Apply adopter-specific presentation choices over the portable basis.

layers.title: Realization rules
layers.description: Apply mechanically auditable typography, layout, projection, and accessibility constraints.
